Measu"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"red cost was too high: each JSONL event is **339 bytes** (the text is only 46 of them, because `cont"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ent` and `sections` each store a copy) and it wrote one **every turn**."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Inactive under fixed-prompt presets**: if a preset's persona sets `includeRuntimeContext: false`"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" (the official `minimal` and the local `simple-reply` both do), `assemble()` returns `contexts: []` "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"and this plugin's entry is dropped wholesale. Those presets are designed to forbid later listeners f"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"rom adding anything to the prompt.
- **Old snapshots stay in history**: when the date changes the pl"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"atform appends a new snapshot (the old one is kept) and the new one takes effect through its own "Th"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"is snapshot supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots" declaration — the same way the platform ha"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"ndles cwd / sandbox / approval policy changes.
- **Bundle patches are not hot-reloaded**: changing `"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"cordis.patch.yml` or upgrading the plugin requires a dsh web restart (changing `disabled` in the pro"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"file patch is hot).
- **`dsh-time-context` is neither loaded nor filtered**: if you mount it explici"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"tly in a preset, its verbose text appears as usual. Do not use both.
- **No runtime probe for the co"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"ntract point**: `systemPrompt.context` is called unguarded, so a future DSH rename would surface as "},{"id":"p26s12","text":"a plugin load failure instead of a silent degradation (see `HANDOVER.md` §7)."}],"truncated":true}
